verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The government is not running any scheme to provide free mobile recharges. Messages and videos claiming this are fake and are part of a scam to defraud people.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple Tier 1 fact-checking organizations and official government sources, including the Press Information Bureau (PIB), have consistently debunked this claim over several years. The evidence shows that no such free recharge scheme exists. Reports explicitly label these viral messages and links as fraudulent attempts to scam or phish for personal information. One government source also notes that a viral video associated with the claim is AI-generated.

signals_ai: A government source (PIB Fact Check Unit) stated a viral video making this claim is AI-generated (ws-1).
A fact-checking organization stated a similar video was edited (fc-1).
